data.title: Fix perf ACK framing and reject binding or macro smuggling
data.description: Consumes frozen perf ACKs as exact ack LF NUL frames, preserves the existing ack-LF ledger, emits perf_disable in canonical order, and hardens overlay validation against comments, dead code, unreachable flow, local PERF_ACK_WIRE shadowing, local const/static items, and non-whitelisted macros. Required ACK references are blanked before rejecting any remaining binding occurrence; only vec, assert, and assert_eq macro calls are permitted. All hostile static cases, runner suites, cargo/fmt checks, and real perf/strace rehearsals pass.
